steps.note: LOCKED (unsourceable Model metadata): the SDK's Provider.models[].Model requires api{id,url,npm}, per-token cost, limit, status and release_date. The daemon's catalog exposes real capabilities and a pricing STATE (Known|Unknown) precisely so unknown prices are never faked as 0, and it knows no npm package/release date; emitting models with fabricated metadata (or omitting the real catalog) would be worse than the honest 404. Locked until a faithful metadata projection exists.

LOCKED (platform-dependent backend): the SDK posts POST /pty and expects the Pty object; the daemon's real PTY ops live at /pty/create, so the SDK path is honestly unregistered (404). The trace's command is POSIX `sh` while the real backend is platform-specific (ConPTY on Windows) and fails honestly there, so a 200 golden could not be an exact pass on every CI platform; the SDK's interactive connect route is also unregistered. Locked rather than half-implementing the PTY lifecycle.

Exact pass: GET /permission answers the SDK-declared bare PermissionRequest[] over the daemon's REAL pending permission requests (every class): capability -> permission, the requested target strings -> patterns, the full capability payload -> metadata, always [] because this slice keeps no always-allow rules.

Exact pass: GET /question answers the SDK-declared bare QuestionRequest[]. This slice has no structured-question subsystem — its question-class asks ARE permission requests and ride GET /permission — so the truthful projection is the empty array, never a fabricated question/option object.

Exact pass: GET /network answers the SDK-declared bare SessionNetworkWait[]. The SDK type is a network RECONNECT wait with a required creation time; the daemon has no reconnect-wait state (network-class asks ride GET /permission), so the truthful projection is the empty array, never a fabricated wait/timestamp.

LOCKED (SSE multiplexing / no frame corpus): the request bytes (GET /global/event, auth) and the opened 200 text/event-stream are transport-locked, but the replay does not golden-compare SSE frame bodies (an idle harness emits no event), and the daemon's journal/global envelope is not the SDK's multiplexed GlobalEvent union (directory/project/workspace + payload union). Note-locked until an SDK-union frame corpus can be replayed.
Exact pass: the SDK-declared 200: boolean true after every live session is durably ended (idempotent; an incomplete dispose is an error response, never false).
Exact pass: alias of /global/dispose; the SDK-declared boolean true after every live session is durably ended (idempotent).
Exact pass: the SDK-declared 200: boolean true after the idempotent crash-recovery sweep (recover()).
